This document outlines the high pressure heater inspection which must be performed every 
 8000 hours of operation

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Goma Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station
The high pressure heater technical data
Flow rate of feeding water 320 m3/hr
حجم سطح سخان الضغط العالي لكل سخان : 320 م2

A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
